Редактор и генератор карт. Мод занимаетс: A map editor and generator. This mod deals with maps only: it grants no currency, unlocks no upgrades or towers, marks no levels as completed and never modifies the game's levels.
Свои карты и карты из папки обмена. Прох: Your maps and maps from the shared folder. Completing them does not count towards Steam and grants no rewards.
Свои карты — в папке сохранений игры. Ка: Your own maps live in the game's save folder. Maps shared by other players go in the mod's shared folder: drop a .json there and it appears in the editor list marked "shared".
Своя карта живёт в отдельном слоте и уро: Your map lives in a separate slot and never replaces a game level — the campaign stays untouched.
Своя карта живёт в отдельном слоте и шта: Your map lives in a separate slot and does NOT occupy any of the game's levels. Orc speed in this game comes from the level number (45 + 5 × number), so the mod holds it manually.
